head.h1: Gluten Free Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Gluten free catering in Dubai starts from AED 700 per person and puts safe, naturally gluten-free food at the centre of your table, not a sad side plate parked in the corner. MyCHEF matches you with a vetted private chef who plans the menu coeliac-aware, cooks it on site, serves it and clears up afterwards. Send your date, guest count and venue and you will have a readable, itemised proposal promptly during our published business hours.

replace_in_block.new_heading: What is on a gluten free menu?
new_paragraphs: A good gluten free menu in Dubai reads like any other menu, built from ingredients that are naturally free of gluten or carefully substituted. We plan around naturally gluten-free mains such as grilled seafood, slow-cooked meats, rice and legume dishes, then add gluten-free pasta, fresh-baked gluten-free breads and desserts so the courses feel complete. Global cuisines adapt well: Levantine mezze, Italian risotto, Indian dals and South-East Asian rice bowls are gluten-free by nature or easily made so. Sauces, marinades and dressings hide the usual traps, so those are rebuilt from scratch with gluten-free stocks and tamari in place of soy. Share the guest list and we shape the gluten free food catering around real preferences. You can browse sample menus for a sense of range before we tailor anything.

add_block.new_heading: What does gluten free catering in Dubai include?
new_paragraphs: It includes everything from the first menu conversation to the last plate cleared, delivered by one gluten free catering company, not a patchwork of suppliers. A dedicated chef designs a menu around your guests and the occasion, sources naturally gluten-free ingredients, cooks on site in your kitchen or a hired one, and brings the service staff, plating and equipment needed to run the meal. Because everything is prepared for your event and not pulled from a shared production line, cross-contact is controlled from the ground up instead of trusted to a label. You choose the depth: a relaxed drop-off of gluten-free food, a full plated dinner with front-of-house service, or interactive live stations. Whatever the format, the gluten free catering services on offer cover the whole job: planning, cooking, serving and the cleanup you would otherwise be left with.

add_block.new_heading: Gluten free catering for weddings, corporate events and parties
new_paragraphs: Any occasion can be catered fully gluten-free without the celiac guest feeling like an afterthought. For weddings your chef plates a menu the whole table shares, so the coeliac guest is not handed a separate "special" dish. For business, corporate gluten free catering covers boardroom lunches, conferences and staff dinners where dietary requests arrive from every direction. For celebrations, gluten free party catering keeps grazing tables, canapés and dessert spreads entirely safe to eat. We regularly run gluten free catering for events from a twelve-seat dinner to a few hundred guests, adjusting the format (buffet, plated or stations) to the room and the run of show. Tell us who is coming and what the day looks like, and the menu is built to match the moment, not forced into a fixed package.

add_block.new_heading: Where do the gluten-free bread and the cake come from?
new_paragraphs: Bread and cake are the part most gluten-free catering quietly gives up on, and they are worth asking about before you book. Gluten-free baking is a separate craft with its own flours, hydration and timings, and it does not happen well as an afterthought on a busy event line. There are two honest routes. Some items are baked fresh in the event kitchen on the day — flatbreads, focaccia, polenta-based sides, brownies and flourless chocolate cake all work this way and taste better for it. Others are ordered in from a Dubai bakery whose main business is gluten-free baking, which is the sensible route for layered celebration cakes, pastries and loaves that need a proper proving schedule. Neither route is automatically better. What matters is that you know which one your menu uses, because a bought-in bakery item carries whatever controls that bakery operates, not the ones agreed for your event. We tell you which items are baked on site and which are sourced, and the arrangement is confirmed with the assigned culinary partner before you commit.

add_block.new_heading: How is cross-contact and coeliac safety handled?
new_paragraphs: Dietary note: for severe coeliac needs, kitchen cross-contact protocols are confirmed with the business first, and we do not guarantee a gluten-free environment without that confirmation. That honesty is the point. Where a guest is medically coeliac, the chef works with dedicated boards, utensils, pans and fryer oil, preps gluten-containing items separately or removes them from the menu, and stores ingredients to avoid contact. Labels are read for hidden gluten in stocks, spice blends and condiments. Tell us at enquiry exactly who is affected and how strict the requirement is, so the chef can plan the kitchen setup ahead of the day. For lighter gluten-sensitivity or mixed tables, we run a gluten-free menu with sensible care. Either way you get a clear, truthful account of what we can control.

add_block.new_heading: Gluten-free restaurants in Dubai, or catering at home?
new_paragraphs: Dubai eats out well on a gluten-free diet these days, and for a normal Tuesday that is the right answer. There are dedicated gluten-free kitchens and bakeries across the city, and the larger food halls — the Dubai Mall floors among them — now mark menus clearly enough that searching for a gluten-free restaurant in Dubai, or specifically gluten free restaurants in Dubai Mall, will find you lunch. What eating out does not solve is hosting. In a restaurant you take the kitchen as you find it: a shared line, a shared fryer, and a requirement relayed by a waiter to a chef you never speak to. Catering turns that around. The menu is designed around your table before a single ingredient is bought, the chef planning it hears the requirement from you directly, and the kitchen setup for the day is agreed in advance rather than negotiated at the pass. The practical rule is about numbers. A dinner for two is usually a restaurant booking. Once a gluten-free guest is one of twenty, or the whole table needs to eat the same food, catering is normally both calmer and cheaper per head than trying to make a restaurant accommodate a group.

add_block.new_heading: How much does gluten free catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Gluten free catering in Dubai opens at AED 700 per person, and the final figure moves with your numbers, menu and service style. Buffet and drop-off formats are our lowest per-head formats; plated service with a full team of staff sits higher; a luxury multi-course dinner with premium ingredients is higher again. Because prices are quoted to the event and not fixed, a larger guest count usually lowers the per-person cost. Set catering packages and per-person menus are both available so you can compare value directly, and the quote itemises every line, from food and chef to staff and equipment, with no vague bundles. For worked examples across formats, see our Dubai catering price guide , then ask for an itemised gluten free catering quote built to your brief.

add_block.new_heading: Planning gluten free catering step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue — your proposal arrives.
Book gluten free catering about 2 weeks ahead off-peak, and 6 weeks ahead between November and March.
Confirm the menu for gluten free catering some 7 days ahead, once numbers stop moving.
Ask for dietary covers at the gluten free catering briefing stage instead of within 48 hours .
Check parking and lift access; your gluten free catering team is on site some 2 hours early.
Plan on roughly 3 hours of service, and add 5% VAT to the total.

new_paragraphs: How much does gluten free catering cost in Dubai?

Pricing opens at roughly AED 700 per person and moves with your numbers, menu and service level. Buffet and drop-off formats cost less per head than plated service with staff, and larger guest counts usually bring the per-person figure down.
Can you cater to strict coeliac or allergy needs?

Yes, tell us the specifics when you enquire. For severe coeliac needs, kitchen cross-contact protocols are confirmed with the business first; we do not guarantee a gluten-free environment without that confirmation, and we would sooner be honest than promise what we cannot control.
What is included in gluten free catering?

Included is the whole job: menu planning and tasting, a vetted chef cooking on site, service and front-of-house staff where needed, plating, and full setup and cleanup, with one team running the event end to end.
Is there gluten free catering near me in Dubai?
Near you, yes: chefs travel to homes, villas, offices and event venues across Dubai, so the service comes to you instead of you hunting for a nearby kitchen.
Can you cater gluten free food for large events and parties?

Large events are no problem. We scale gluten free catering for events, corporate functions and private parties from an intimate dinner to a few hundred guests using buffet, plated or live-station formats.
Do you offer gluten free catering packages?
Offered both ways: per-person menus and set catering packages. The quote lists exactly what each option includes so you can weigh cost against value before you decide.
How do I book?
Booking starts with your date, guest count and venue; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
For gluten free catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Why myCHEF for gluten free catering
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. Every chef working on gluten free catering has cleared identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews , a continuous standard and not a one-time tick. We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the best available chef for it, which is what makes for genuinely reliable gluten free catering, not a marketing claim.

For dietary-led menus like this, that is often Ahmed Al-Rashid , who brings 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique. He designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, times and seasons every course to exacting standards, and is meticulous about allergen control. Our work spans gluten free catering, villa weddings, yacht celebrations and corporate galas across Dubai. Covers gluten free catering; client reviews go up as events are delivered.
